title: Generic List Component
description: Learn how to create a reusable generic list component.

data.text: **Generic components** work with any type while maintaining type safety. A generic list is a common example.

data.title: Generic List

terms.definition: Passing a function as a prop to control rendering
A component parameterized by a type

data.title: Type Inference
data.text: TypeScript infers the generic type from the items prop, so you don't need to specify it explicitly.

items.question: Why do I need keyExtractor as a prop?
items.answer: React needs stable keys for list items. By passing keyExtractor, the generic list knows how to extract unique keys from any data type.

items.question: Can I use index as key?
items.answer: Only if the list is static and won't reorder. For dynamic lists, always use a unique identifier from your data.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Generic components work with any type
Maintain type safety across different uses
data.takeaway: Generic components are powerful for reusable UI.
